This '''[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|general]]''' commanded [[Gamma Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], launched [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] to locate Rebels fleeing [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|destruction]] of [[Anchorhead Base]]. When his [[Unidentified Gamma Base communications officer|communications officer]] detected a probe droid on Hoth, the general dispatched [[Rookie One]] to investigate and destroy it. When Rookie One confirmed the presence of probe droids, the Rebels were forced to [[Battle of Hoth (0 BBY)|evacuate]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Navander_Button.png|thumb|left|Carlist Rieekan and [[Romas Navander/Legends|Romas Navander]] in ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
The Gamma Base commander appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' by [[Vincent Lee]]. The game depicts a battle between Imperial and Rebel forces on Hoth, three years prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] shown in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. When producing the cut-scenes for the game, the production staff used footage from the [[original trilogy]], editing in footage of members of the game's production staff over the faces of the movie characters. The scene involving the Gamma Base commander was taken from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' with LucasArts artist [[Steve Purcell]] taking the place of General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]].<ref name="RA:TOIG">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide]]''</ref>
